analysis:
Examined units cover InferenceHandler head lines 620-1556, which are unchanged context; the changes are at lines 135 and 513. They also cover the MTPUpgrade base text plus the patch adding transitionGenerations.begin(.modelLoading) at head line 127.

InferenceHandler context still fails closed on encryption errors (T-008). precomputeSharedKey failure (head 797-815) and per-chunk encryptPayloadFast failure (822-842) send an encryptionFailure terminal and send no plaintext. Cache scope plumbing is unchanged: remoteCache.scope reaches the Super owner, cacheScope reaches MultiModelBatchSchedulerEngine, and cacheResult is gated on scope (1519) (T-041). Billing-floor logic is unchanged.

Changed admission lines 135 and 513 replace autopilotAllowsModel with autopilotServesModel. These lines fall outside the supplied head_text units. The autopilotServesModel semantics are also not supplied. Integration should verify that the new predicate is at least as strict for managed network work and owner-local work. This is an availability and routing-policy question with no evident confidentiality impact.

The MTPUpgrade change marks a modelLoading transition generation when MTP staging sets isLoadingAny. This appears to strengthen invalidation and coordination, consistent with T-053 and TB-011 generation semantics. The transitionGenerations implementation and its consumers are not supplied, including whether begin() requires a matching end or finish. If no matching end call is made, the provider might stay perpetually in a loading transition, which is a possible DoS. Integration should confirm against the transitionGenerations source.

No concrete regression was identified in the visible evidence.
